prompts:
Use case: identity-preserve / precise animation correction.
Asset type: six-frame looping down-right WALK sprite sheet for a 2D game.
Input 1 is the CHARACTER reference. Use ONLY the lower row (front three-quarter southeast view). Preserve the hunter's identity, head, hood, face, red eyes, burgundy scarf, purple short cape, brown boots, belt and orange charm, pixel clusters and shading. Her torso faces DOWN-RIGHT in every output frame; never a back view. Empty hands, front right fist held near waist for a separate gun.
Input 2 is an ANATOMICAL POSE GUIDE, not art to reproduce. Its blue line is the left/far leg and orange line is the right/near leg. Follow the six different LEG POSITIONS and their order exactly, but render both legs in the hunter's normal clothing colors. No blue or orange limbs, guide text, grid, ground line, or diagram graphics in the result.
PRIMARY FIX: the reference sprites have one permanently tucked-up foot. Replace that with a true complete alternating walk. The left leg must travel from behind the body to in front, and the right leg must do the opposite. Do not output six variations of one pose. The entire point is the DIFFERENT LEG POSES.
Output exactly SIX full-body sprites, in a clean THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS arrangement with ample transparent gutters:
1 TOP LEFT: RIGHT FOOT FORWARD CONTACT. BOTH boots flat on the SAME baseline. Left/far leg straight trailing behind, right/near leg straight forward, a compact split stance.
2 TOP MIDDLE: Right foot planted. Left boot lifts and passes underneath the hips. Small bent left knee; right leg supporting.
3 TOP RIGHT: Right foot still supporting behind, LEFT knee and LEFT boot swing forward IN FRONT of the body (NOT permanently trailing).
4 BOTTOM LEFT: LEFT FOOT FORWARD CONTACT, opposite to frame 1. BOTH boots flat on the SAME baseline. Left/far leg is now straight forward, right/near leg straight trailing. The two anatomical legs have traded places.
5 BOTTOM MIDDLE: Left foot planted. RIGHT boot lifts and passes underneath hips; the opposite knee bends compared with frame 2.
6 BOTTOM RIGHT: Left foot supporting behind, RIGHT knee and RIGHT boot swing forward IN FRONT, opposite to frame 3, then loop to frame 1.
Keep the upper body nearly locked across all frames; match head size, proportions, scale and hood center. Slight scarf/cape secondary motion only. Make BOTH feet readable, especially two distinct flat soles in contact frames 1 and 4. Never hide a whole boot in the cape. Compact natural strides, no leap or run crouch.
Style: crisp pixel art matching reference, dark outline and flat compact shading, no glow, no shadows, no effects, no backgrounds, no text. TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Sprite sheet with large safe margins around each full figure; no cropping or touching cells.

Edit target: input image 1, a six-frame hunter sheet. Input 2 is the leg anatomy guide. Preserve transparent background, upper bodies, size, layout, hood, face, clothing, weapons-free hands and pixel style.
The TOP ROW is now acceptable. Keep all three top-row sprites unchanged.
CRITICAL CORRECTION ONLY TO THE BOTTOM ROW: its leg poses currently repeat the top row! The bottom row MUST be the opposite anatomical half-step, as shown in the bottom row of the colored guide. The near/right leg has the lighter boot and starts on the right side of the hips. The far/left leg has the darker boot and starts on the left.
Bottom LEFT sprite (frame 4): BOTH soles on a common horizontal baseline, but SWAP THE LEGS compared to top left: the DARK far/left leg extends diagonally FORWARD to screen RIGHT, and the LIGHT near/right leg extends diagonally BACKWARD to screen LEFT. Their shin positions cross. Visibly different from top left. Do not simply repeat the same split stance.
Bottom MIDDLE (frame 5): the DARK far/left boot is planted FORWARD at screen RIGHT. The LIGHT near/right boot is lifted BEHIND at screen LEFT. This is the opposite supporting leg to top middle.
Bottom RIGHT (frame 6): the DARK far/left boot remains planted beneath/behind the body. The LIGHT near/right boot now swings from behind and passes UNDER THE HIPS, pointing down, about to return to the top-left contact. No permanently kicked-up foot.
Keep heads/torso/hip position unchanged and edit only the legs below the belt in the bottom three sprites. Six distinct gait phases, NOT a repeated three-pose cycle. No captions, guides, shadows, effects or ground. True transparency.
